newsitem.title: USA: Arkansas governor declares flooding disaster.
newsitem.headline: Arkansas governor declares flooding disaster.

text.p: - Gov. Mike Huckabee Tuesday declared 23 counties in southern Arkansas disaster areas after steady rains since Saturday flooded hundreds of homes and businesses.
"We're uncertain as to how many people have had to evacuate because some have been able to return as the water levels have fallen," said Ray Briggler of the Arkansas Office of Emergency Services.

But Briggler said that, at one point, as many as 700 people were forced from their homes in Ouachita County, Ark. The Red Cross opened a shelter Tuesday night in a National Guard armory in Camden, Ark., the Ouachita County seat.
"We issued the disaster delaration the moment we had the necessary paperwork from local officials," said Rex Nelson, Huckabee's press secretary.
"It's hard to make a damage estimate from flooding because the water has to recede before any accurate inspection can be made," Nelson said.
Local officials, however, said scores of roads and a number of bridges had been washed away by the floods and that damage to public property alone would total many millions of dollars.
The Federal Emergency Management Agency said it would begin its assessment of the damage Wednesday.
